title: Shipping fee
goal:
Before: the fee is 5 plus 1 per 2 kg over 10 kg, and 0 from a total of 100; express is not handled (weight 14, total 50 → 7; total 80 → 7; total 100 → 0).
Change: shipping is now free from a total of 80, and express (express == 1) adds 7, even when shipping is free (total 80 → 0; total 50, express → 14; total 100, express → 7); nothing else changes.
Constraints: do not change the line fee = base + extra + rush; or the if statements for weight and express.

keep.desc: constraint 1: the line fee = base + extra + rush; is unchanged
keep.desc_ko: 제약 1: fee = base + extra + rush; 줄이 그대로

keep.desc: constraint 2: the weight if is unchanged: if (weight > 10) { extra = weight / 2 - 5; }
keep.desc_ko: 제약 2: weight if가 그대로: if (weight > 10) { extra = weight / 2 - 5; }

keep.desc: constraint 2: the express if is unchanged: if (express == 1) { rush = 7; }
keep.desc_ko: 제약 2: express if가 그대로: if (express == 1) { rush = 7; }

goal_ko:
원래: 배송비는 5에 10kg을 넘는 2kg마다 1을 더하고, 합계가 100 이상이면 0입니다. express는 다루지 않습니다 (weight 14, total 50 → 7; total 80 → 7; total 100 → 0).
변경: 합계 80부터 무료배송이고, express(express == 1)는 무료배송이어도 7을 더합니다 (total 80 → 0; total 50, express → 14; total 100, express → 7). 그 밖의 동작은 바뀌지 않습니다.
제약: fee = base + extra + rush; 줄과 weight·express if 문은 고치지 마세요.
